ValidationRule.description: Date/DateTime fields are matched with Contains_Text__c (a date literal) plus Text_Operator__c, never Minimum/Maximum. Contains and Starts With are text-only: the component ignores them on a real date, and a blank operator defaults to Contains.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( LOWER( Indicator_Item__r.Field__r.DataType ) = 'date' || LOWER( Indicator_Item__r.Field__r.DataType ) = 'datetime' ) && ( ISBLANK( Contains_Text__c ) || ISPICKVAL( Text_Operator__c, '' ) || ISPICKVAL( Text_Operator__c, 'Contains' ) || ISPICKVAL( Text_Operator__c, 'Starts With' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date and Date/Time fields need a date value (a relative date such as TODAY or NEXT 30 DAYS, or a fixed date as YYYY-MM-DD) and a date operator: Equals, Does Not Equal, Before Start, After Start, Before End or After End.
